name: Slow Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Rosemary Potatoes

components.name: Slow-Roasted Lamb & Gravy

ingredients.name: Raw bone-in lamb shoulder, including bone weight
Raw onion quarters in roasting pan

steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Cut small slits into the lamb shoulder and press garlic and rosemary into the slits; rub with oil, salt and pepper.
Place onion quarters and water into a deep tray, set lamb over them and cover tightly. Lower oven temperature to 165-170 C and roast for roughly 3-3.5 hours until fork tender.
Uncover and raise heat to 220 C for 15-20 minutes so the exterior browns. Rest lamb before pulling the edible meat away from bones and excess cartilage.
Strain pan drippings, skim excess fat, mix measured stock and flour to form a light gravy over medium heat and add lemon.
Weigh only the separated edible cooked lamb for the final yield test, then portion lamb, potatoes and gravy into six meals.

components.name: Rosemary Roast Potatoes
steps: When the lamb has about 45 minutes left, toss potatoes with olive oil, garlic powder, rosemary and salt, then roast on a separate tray until tender and browned.
